name: bpmn-process
description: Evaluate and improve BPMN Process drawings — a process that must follow bpmn notation for a technical or compliance audience
goal: Reach a consistent 16+/20, with every node connected and drawn from a BPMN_M.VSSX master

prompts.text: Build a BPMN process for insurance claims intake, from the claim submitted event through assessment to a decision gateway
Build a BPMN process for order-to-cash with a start event, tasks for validation, fulfilment and invoicing, and an end event
Build a BPMN collaboration for a loan application, with a pool for the applicant and one for the bank
Build a BPMN process for support ticket handling with a gateway on severity and a sub-process for escalation
